[Verse 1]
[G]I lit out from Reno, I was
[C]trailed by twenty hounds
[G]Didn't get to sleep last night Till the
[C]morning came around

[Chorus]
[D]Set out runnin but I take my time
[Am]A friend of the devil is a friend of mine If
[D]I get home before daylight,
[Am]Just might get some sleep to-
[D]night

[Verse 2]
[G]Ran into the devil, babe, He
[C]loaned me twenty bills
[G]Spent the night in Utah In a
[C]cave up in the hills

[Chorus]
[D]Set out runnin but I take my time, A
[Am]friend of the devil is a friend of mine

[Am]Just might get some sleep to-
[D]night

[G]Ran down to the levee But the
[C]devil caught me there
[G]Took my twenty dollar bill And
[C]vanished in the air

[Chorus]
[D]Set out runnin but I take my time
[Am]A friend of the devil is a friend of mine
[D]I get home before daylight,
[Am]Just might get some sleep to-
[D]night

[Bridge]
[D]Got two reasons why I cry a-
way Lonely night:
[C]First one's named sweet Anne Marie,
She's my heart's delight
[D]Second one is prison, babe, The
sheriff's on my trail
[Am]If he catches up with me, I'll spend
[C]my life in [D]jail

[C]one in Cherokee
